scope_note: Authoritative current technical snapshot. Integrity/replay and agent-authored development probes are not clinical validation.

policy_probe.provenance: Agent-authored development probes; the wording was used to discover/fix policy gaps. In-sample, not blind, independent or representative. Text-only: no attached pixels or attachment metadata processed.

warnings: One Starlette TestClient AnyIO BlockingPortal deprecation warning
tests.interpretation: Full and targeted software regression after expanded personal-image outcome/context routing. Does not establish independent retrieval performance, attachment handling, clinical validity, or acceptance for medical use.

open_acceptance_gates: new blind evaluation set with locked protocol
independent image cohort with rights, patient-level provenance and checkpoint-overlap audit
image-level rights-chain verification for BTXRD upstream Radiopaedia/MedPix materials before any redistribution, commercial use or derivative image reuse

expansion_dev.interpretation: 22 positive/3 negative; query wording and routing were viewed/tuned on this development set. In-sample only; flat gold lists do not define alternative evidence groups.

viewed_v2_regression.interpretation: 8 positive/6 negative; previously viewed and route-adjusted. Regression only, not held-out validation.

strict_lexical_expansion_dev.interpretation: Only 1/22 positive cases passes current lexical verification; 21/22 positives abstain. Lexical coverage is not entailment.

ofd_dev.interpretation: Five positive/two policy-negative agent-authored in-sample cases; strict lexical check passes 1/5 positives. Narrative review is not a guideline or dataset-label definition.

nci_osteochondroma_dev.interpretation: Two agent-authored in-sample probes: general definition retrieved; unsupported BTXRD mapping abstains. Not validation.

image_routing_dev.interpretation: 30 agent-authored in-sample negative text probes; all route to specialist-assessment abstention. Sentence-level matching keeps an unrelated patient mention in a separate general-education sentence from triggering the block. Does not inspect uploaded image pixels or attachment metadata.

cohort_candidates.cohort: 1,305 pathology-confirmed patients across two centers; independent center-level test set 262 patients, X-rays available for 233
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: Two radiologists independently reviewed histopathology diagnoses and assigned benign/intermediate/malignant under WHO 2020
cohort_candidates.endpoint: Benign / intermediate / malignant; multimodal study, not the current ten-subtype endpoint
cohort_candidates.availability: No public image package or patient manifest located; article says no datasets were generated or analysed despite reporting cohorts, so access statement needs clarification
cohort_candidates.status: Candidate to request; paper's external split does not prove independence from the BoneScope checkpoint, BTXRD, or pretraining; shares authors/Guangzhou institutional network with Xie et al. 2024, so overlap between the two cohorts must be clarified. Article CC BY 4.0 does not license patient images

cohort_candidates.cohort: 2,899 images / 1,356 patients; external test 639 images / 291 patients from two centers
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: histopathology; internal CV grouped by patient ID
cohort_candidates.status: candidate to request; access, rights, manifest and checkpoint overlap are unverified

cohort_candidates.study: Li et al., Insights into Imaging 2026
cohort_candidates.cohort: 471 Ruijin patients; one representative radiograph per patient
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: pathology confirmed per paper; third-reader consensus described for region annotation disagreements, not clearly diagnostic labels
cohort_candidates.status: Paper reports Ruijin did not contribute to BTXRD and is geographically distinct, supporting source-level independence; data, rights, patient manifest and image-level checkpoint-overlap audit remain unavailable/unverified.

cohort_candidates.cohort: 1,044 development patients; internal test 354; validation 171; external 423; three Chinese hospitals; bone tumors and infections
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: Primary bone tumors classified per WHO 2020; infections confirmed by histology and/or culture; ROI annotation by two radiologists
cohort_candidates.endpoint: Tumor versus infection / broader tumor-infection classification; not the current ten-subtype endpoint
cohort_candidates.availability: Restricted Zenodo files; request for noncommercial academic use under formal MTA and institutional review; article cites DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13858807 while matching-title Zenodo record found is 10.5281/zenodo.13858808
cohort_candidates.status: High-priority request candidate only. DOI mismatch, data rights, license, patient-level manifest, split IDs and checkpoint/pretraining overlap unresolved; no files accessed

cohort_candidates.study: von Schacky et al., RSNA Radiology 2021 / European Radiology 2022
cohort_candidates.cohort: 2021: Munich 934 internal and Freiburg 111 external; 2022: Munich 880 and Freiburg 96; related 2024 metadata paper: 804 patients / 1,785 radiographs, 2000-2020
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: Histopathology; radiologist review reported in the 2022 study
cohort_candidates.endpoint: Binary benign versus malignant, suitable only for a separately specified binary evaluation
cohort_candidates.availability: No public image package or data-access route found in reviewed article/repository pages; model code repository does not include images
cohort_candidates.status: Potentially related cohort family, exact overlap unverified. Do not sum cohort counts or treat as independent external data; article licenses do not establish image rights

cohort_candidates.study: SNUH-BoneTumor dataset described in SKELEX, npj Digital Medicine 2026
cohort_candidates.cohort: 19,757 anatomically cropped radiographs; count is images, not patients
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: Image-level annotations by a board-certified orthopedic oncologist; pathology when available, otherwise radiographic findings and clinical history with CT/MRI support; authors acknowledge label heterogeneity
cohort_candidates.endpoint: Multiple musculoskeletal labels including bone tumor; not a verified fit to the ten-class BoneScope endpoint
cohort_candidates.availability: Reasonable request; case-by-case institutional, privacy and IP review
cohort_candidates.status: Request candidate only. Used in SKELEX tumor-classifier training, so not external for that checkpoint; BoneScope overlap and image-use rights are unverified

cohort_candidates.study: Xie et al., European Journal of Radiology 2024
cohort_candidates.cohort: 878 pathology-confirmed patients from two centers; 638 train, 77 validation, 80 internal test, 83 external test
cohort_candidates.endpoint: Five broad histological groups; not the current ten-subtype endpoint
cohort_candidates.availability: No public image package or accessible data-use terms located in reviewed sources
cohort_candidates.status: Request candidate only. Shares authors and Guangzhou institutional network with Song et al. 2024; possible cohort overlap is unproven and must be resolved before treating as an independent source. Rights, patient-level manifest, external center independence and BoneScope checkpoint/pretraining overlap unverified

cohort_candidates.study: Shao et al. and Xu et al., Guangdong/Sun Yat-sen knee radiograph studies 2024
cohort_candidates.cohort: Shao: 333 pathology-confirmed patients, osteolytic osteosarcoma vs GCT, 54 external across three centers; Xu: 687 tumor patients + 1,988 normal participants, external 56 tumor + 145 normal
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: Shao: postoperative pathology for both labels; Xu: tumor labels based on histopathology or radiography with CT/MRI/clinical follow-up; normal controls reviewed by senior radiologists
cohort_candidates.endpoint: Shao narrow two-class OS-vs-GCT; Xu knee tumor detection/tumor-vs-normal; neither is the general ten-subtype endpoint
cohort_candidates.availability: Both studies say data are available/shared on reasonable request
cohort_candidates.status: Request as one potentially related four-center cohort family until custodians resolve shared centers/patients. Image rights, patient-level manifests and BoneScope checkpoint/pretraining overlap unverified

cohort_candidates.study: Yamana et al., Bone & Joint Research 2025
cohort_candidates.cohort: 642 biopsy/resection-confirmed cases across three Kyushu hospitals; 1,129 radiographs; 40 diagnoses
cohort_candidates.reference_standard: Pathology diagnosis by experienced musculoskeletal pathologists; intermediate types grouped with malignant for the binary task
cohort_candidates.endpoint: Broad benign/malignant classification and detection; not the ten-subtype BoneScope endpoint
cohort_candidates.availability: Other researchers may request data; no image package, manifest, image rights grant, or data-use terms verified
cohort_candidates.status: Request-only candidate. Main evaluation is random five-fold case-level CV within the source cohort; reader comparison uses a selected subset and is not independent external testing. Article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 does not itself license patient images. Need rights, patient/image manifest, checkpoint/pretraining overlap audit, and confirmation of any separately held locked external set.

reporting_standards_reviewed.name: CLAIM 2024 Update
reporting_standards_reviewed.application: Patient-level partitioning, reference standard, annotation/adjudication, and explicit internal versus external testing are recorded as image-cohort gate requirements; CLAIM does not validate this text-retrieval system.

reporting_standards_reviewed.name: DECIDE-AI
reporting_standards_reviewed.application: Reserved for any later live clinical-workflow evaluation; offline retrieval metrics do not satisfy this scope.

data_review.note: Official primary literature and reporting guidance are documented. No external patient-level image dataset has been accessed or authorized.

additional_2026_btxrd_reuse_review.disposition: same BTXRD lineage; not independent or a new external cohort; image-level split due missing patient IDs; not ingested into the clinical disease corpus

additional_screened_dataset_exclusions.name: BoneMet (ICLR 2025)
additional_screened_dataset_exclusions.reason: Murine breast-cancer bone-metastasis dataset; serial rotational X-rays/CT and animal-level labels, not human primary bone tumor cohort; repository states CC BY-NC 4.0
